literature.title: Guanylin and uroguanylin regulate electrolyte transport in isolated human cortical collecting ducts.
literature.abstract: Guanylin and uroguanylin link intestinal and renal electrolyte and water transport. Their function in intestine is well studied, but renal actions are less understood. Uroguanylin concentrations are increased in patients with chronic renal failure, nephrotic syndrome, or those on dialysis. Guanylate cyclase C (GC-C) is the receptor first described for these peptides. In guanylate cyclase C-deficient mice guanylin- and uroguanylin-induced renal natriuresis, kaliuresis, and diuresis are retained.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 慢性腎衰竭常伴隨 ENaC 上調（繼發性醛固酮增多症、腎素-血管緊張素系統活化），導致鈉滯留與高血壓。Amiloride 透過遠端腎小管 ENaC 阻斷可輔助血壓及鈉平衡控制。然而，腎功能不全導致 Amiloride 藥物蓄積（主要由腎臟排除），使高鉀血症風險顯著增加，此為主要安全限制。NCT02832973（Phase 4）探討序列性腎元阻斷（含 ENaC 阻斷步驟）用於頑固性高血壓合併腎病，提供有限但直接的臨床支撐。
